Class CompiledPredicate

java.lang.Object
gate.sql.condition.Predicate
gate.sql.condition.CompiledPredicate
All Implemented Interfaces:
Clause
public abstract class CompiledPredicate extends Predicate
A single predicate of a compiled condition.
